info.name: Circle of the Broken World
info.description: Circle of the Broken World druid subclass — ATÉRIOR.
info.author: Falling-Cats

description.p: A Druid whose bond runs to nature as it actually exists now — touched by Weaver residue, thinned against the Feywild, home to things unsupervised magic left behind.

Every Druid's power comes from the same bond — a genuine closeness to nature, the land, the wild world outside a settlement's walls. What's changed, five centuries after the Weaver's Touch, is what that world actually is. A Circle of the Broken World Druid isn't a stranger discipline bolted onto ordinary Druidic practice. It's the same bond, honestly applied to what's actually still out there.
Some turn that fluency into a weapon against whatever keeps breaking the world further; others use it to defend what's left, scars included. Both are the same Circle.

p.em: 3rd-level Circle of the Broken World feature

description.p: Whenever you cast a Concentration spell from your Environment Spells list, its area of effect grows by 5 feet at the end of each of your turns after the turn you cast it — radius or side length, whichever applies — to a maximum of twice its original size. Once maxed, it holds there for the rest of the spell's duration.
You always have your Environment and Personal Spells prepared once you reach the level shown; they don't count against the number of spells you can prepare.

sheet.description: Concentration spells from your Environment Spells list grow their area by 5 feet at the end of each of your turns after casting, up to twice their original size.

p.em: 6th-level Circle of the Broken World feature

description.p: You're unaffected by your own Environment Spells' area and effects entirely — their difficult terrain, damage, darkness, and other harmful effects simply don't count you as a target.

When you cast a Personal Spell with a range of Touch, you can target a creature anywhere within the area of your own active Environment Spell, regardless of the distance between you — the magic travels through the corruption to deliver your touch. If the Personal Spell normally requires Concentration, casting it this way doesn't end your Concentration on the Environment Spell; you're considered to be concentrating on both at once, tied to the same thread. If that Concentration is ever broken, both spells end together.

sheet.description: You're unaffected by your own Environment Spells' harmful effects. You can deliver a Touch-range Personal Spell to a creature anywhere within your active Environment Spell's area, regardless of distance, without breaking Concentration on either — but if either loses Concentration, both end together.

p.em: 10th-level Circle of the Broken World feature

description.p: When a creature tries to leave the area of your Environment Spell, you can use your Reaction to force a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it's pulled back to the center and its Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn. On a success, it leaves normally.

sheet.description: When a creature tries to leave the area of your Environment Spell, force a Strength save against your spell save DC. On a failure, it's pulled back to the center and its Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.

p.em: 14th-level Circle of the Broken World feature

description.p: Once per Long Rest, when you cast an Environment Spell, you can manifest a guardian within its area — not a creature you command, but the corrupted ground itself, taking notice. It acts right after your turn, always attacking a hostile creature of your choice within the area. It can't leave the area, be targeted from outside it, or affect anything outside it — if it ever leaves, it simply disappears.

sheet.description: When you cast an Environment Spell, manifest a guardian within its area that acts right after your turn, always attacking a hostile creature you choose within the area. It can't leave, be targeted from outside, or affect anything outside the area.

ul.li: Multiattack. The guardian makes two Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee Attack Roll: your spell attack modifier, reach 10 ft. Hit: 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier Bludgeoning damage.
Binding Strike. If both Tentacle attacks hit the same creature on the same turn, that creature has the Restrained condition until the end of the guardian's next turn.

description.p: When the guardian is reduced to 0 hit points, it collapses and disappears. You must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 10, with disadvantage) to maintain Concentration on the triggering spell.
